changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Confirm your current password, then choose a new one. Your current device stays signed in with a fresh session.
changePassword.passwordHint: Use at least 15 characters. A passphrase works well.
changePassword.successRevoked: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out; this device remains signed in.
changePassword.successKept: Password changed. Your other devices remain signed in; this device has a fresh session.
changePassword.mustDiffer: Choose a new password different from your current one.
changePassword.weak: Choose a stronger password with at least 15 characters.
changePassword.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
changePassword.conflict: Your account changed while this request was in progress. Refresh and try again.
changePassword.error: We could not change your password. Please try again.
changePassword.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
